column1: # UdonSharp rule table — the single place to add or correct a rule.
#   scope    udon   = only files declaring UdonSharpBehaviour
#   kind     literal = compare pattern verbatim (safe for ( ) [ ] etc.)
#   pattern  text to look for, matched against comment/string-masked source
#   absent   ERE whose PRESENCE cancels this rule; use "-" for none
#   message  what to tell the user
# The `absent` column is what keeps this list trustworthy. A rule that fires on
# correct code trains people to ignore the whole output, so anything that is
# only a defect in combination is expressed as "present but missing X".
# ---- hard compile failures in Udon runtime ---------------------------------
